batchnorm: update during shared initial training; freeze running statistics during all five AL rounds in every method
targets: once per independent seed, after shared 40-epoch initial training, on fixed center-cropped 16x8 training anchors; shared by all methods; never tuned with official validation

acquisition.covariance: fresh diagonal class covariance from currently labeled training images; shrinkage 1e-5
acquisition.badge: exact factorized last-linear-weight gradient kernel; no random projection; bias excluded
acquisition.noise_stability: independent full-parameter Gaussian output-deviation implementation; five draws; exact concatenation/no projection; greedy k-center; not authors repository reproduction

study.selection: Highest mean final training-holdout top-1; ties within 1e-12 broken by lowest mean holdout CE, then candidate ID. One fixed and one schedule selected independently. All 24 tuning runs must finish first.
study.schedule_progress: Global post-initialization optimizer-step fraction across all five phases; coefficients refresh at phase starts and nonterminal 100-step boundaries. No observation enters a schedule.
study.transfer: ResNet-18; same selected R50 control settings and frozen Lite; new from-scratch seed-specific initialization, no retuning.
study.negative_outcomes: Retained; no metric-dependent stopping or replacement of seeds.
study.primary_question: Clean-content replication and decomposition of the classification pipeline effect; no guaranteed positive outcome
study.sample_size_rationale: Ten paired confirmation seeds per backbone and ten paired mechanism seeds, fixed before new outcomes. This enables exact-test resolution for the 17-contrast family but is not a power guarantee.
study.multiplicity: One Holm family of 17 predefined contrasts, separately for paired-t and exact sign-flip tests. No adjusted inference before all 206 runs complete.
study.supcon_description: One-view supervised contrastive feature regularizer, temperature 0.1, averaged across layer3/layer4; no projection head. Matched feature-penalty comparison, not reproduction of original two-view SupCon training.
study.scope: One previously used ImageNet-100 dataset, prospectively filtered for exact file and decoded-RGB content duplicates. New seeds, not a new untouched benchmark. No claim of unknown near-duplicate exclusion, upstream label authenticity, robustness or cross-task generalization.
study.pruning: Only checkpoints created in this new result tree: retain shared initialization states and FP32 final model weights; discard superseded optimizer checkpoints after verified successor completion, preserving hash receipts and all traces/evaluations.
study.full_labels: Same shared initialization and post-initialization optimizer step counts as AL; from round1 the entire cleaned training pool is annotated, with the same feedback holdout excluded from gradient batches. Not a separately optimized or convergence-trained full-supervision reference.

data_policy.identity: SHA256 of decoded RGB dimensions and bytes; byte SHA256 also checked against original manifest
data_policy.budgets: floor(clean_train_count/10) initial and per query round; floor(0.05*initial_labels) feedback images are included in annotation budget
